title: Induced EMF magnitude
description: Essential: The student must correctly calculate the motional EMF using the formula E = B L v, obtaining 5 V.

title: Current magnitude
description: Essential: The student must correctly calculate the total current using Ohm's Law for the series circuit, I = E / (R + r), obtaining 1 A.

title: Current direction reasoning
description: Important: The student must apply Lenz's Law or the right-hand rule to determine the direction of the induced current in the rod and the path through the resistor.

title: Force magnitude
description: Essential: The student must correctly calculate the applied force from the magnetic force on the rod at equilibrium, using F = B I L, obtaining 1 N.

title: Circuit analysis
description: Important: The student must recognize the rod and resistor are in series, so the total resistance is R + r for calculating the current.

title: Equilibrium condition
description: Important: The student must state or imply that the pulling force balances the magnetic force because the rod moves at constant velocity.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: The student's work should show units (V, A, N) consistent with the calculated quantities.

title: Incorrect total resistance
description: Pitfall: Using only R or only r in the Ohm's Law calculation for the current, instead of the series sum (R + r).

title: Wrong force formula
description: Pitfall: Using an incorrect formula for the magnetic force (e.g., F = B v L) or the pulling force, neglecting the current.
